steps.what_changes: Agent runs free — no constraints, minimal system prompt
System prompt requires run_tests before final answer
Middleware blocks final answer until run_tests shows all PASSED
Middleware detects repeated code hash; injects alternative-approach warning
Old run_tests ToolMessages pruned before each model call (keep last 3)

primary_metrics: hiddenPassRate (scored on test cases not shown to agent)

hypotheses.self_verification: run_tests usage rate increases vs baseline; hidden pass rate equal or higher
hypotheses.pre_completion: all agents call run_tests at least once; same or better hidden pass rate
hypotheses.loop_detection: loopDetected count decreases repeated failures; cost may increase due to retries
hypotheses.context_pruning: input tokens per problem decrease by removing old ToolMessages; quality unchanged

isolation.public_hidden_split: first 3 test cases public; remaining hidden
